repair_batch.description: Supervisor/operator only: assign push authority for this open batch's candidate branch, preserving the task's canonical branch.

review_notes: Adds exactly one optional string property, repair_batch, to task_set. Removing it restores the publication-delegation catalogue byte for byte; all earlier compatibility records remain unchanged.

Assignment requires Git-first active mode and authenticated supervisor/operator authority for the task project. It binds an open batch in the task integration repository without renaming its canonical task branch. Ordinary workers and raw integration_batch_repair metadata writes cannot grant authority.

Assignment failure preserves explicit boolean success=false. Success delegates to the existing task_show result and appends repair_batch to fields_changed. This argument does not grant PR, default-branch, foreign-repository, rewrite or stale-claim publication rights.
